descriptionPlain:
About Us
Paytm is India's payment Super App offering consumers and merchants most comprehensive
payment services. Pioneer of mobile QR payments revolution in India, today, Paytm is India’s
largest payment company by Users, Merchants, Payment Transactions and Revenue.
Paytm’s mission is to drive financial inclusion in India and bring half a billion Indians into the
mainstream economy through technology-led financial Services. Paytm enables commerce for
small merchants and distributes various financial services offerings to its consumers and
merchants in partnership with financial institutions.
Paytm has been a pioneer in the merchant space by introducing innovative solutions like QR
codes to accept payments and Sound-box to recon payments by voice alerts. We are also
distributing loans to these partners via our ‘Paytm for Business’ App.

Role Overview
 We are looking for a high-performing Hunter Account Director to drive net-new enterprise
business for Pi Commerce. This is a pure hunting role focused on acquiring large enterprise
logos, owning complex sales cycles, and driving revenue growth.
 You will work at the intersection of AI, SaaS, and customer engagement, positioning a
differentiated platform to CXOs across industries.

Key Responsibilities
 Own end-to-end enterprise sales cycle – from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and
closure
 Drive new logo acquisition across large enterprises (BFSI, Retail, Telecom, Healthcare, etc.)
 Build and manage a strong pipeline through outbound hunting, networking, and strategic
account mapping
 Lead CXO-level conversations, optical/articulating value propositions around AI-led
customer engagement
 Conduct deep discovery to understand customer challenges across engagement, retention,
and communication systems
 Collaborable with Pre-Sales, Product, and Solutions teams to design tailored solutions and
demos
 Lead RFP/RFQ responses, proposal development, and commercial negotiations
 Position Pi Commerce as a strategic transformation platform, not just a messaging or
campaign tool
 Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and CRM updates
 Represent Paytm at industry events, client meetings, and strategic forums

What We’re Looking For
 8–15 years of experience in Enterprise SaaS / CPaaS / MarTech / AI platform sales
 Proven track record of closing large, complex enterprise deals (multi-stakeholder, long
sales cycles)
 Strong hunter mindset with demonstrated success in new business acquisition
 Experience engaging with CXOs, business heads, and digital/marketing leaders
 Ability to sell consultatively, translating business problems into technology-led solutions
 Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal structuring and negotiations
 Comfort working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

Why Join This Role
 Be part of a high-growth, strategic business within Paytm
 Sell a category-defining AI-led engagement platform
 Opportunity to work on large enterprise transformations
 High visibility role with direct impact on revenue and market expansion

descriptionPlain:
About Us
Paytm is India's payment Super App offering consumers and merchants the most
comprehensive payment services. As the pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in
India, today Paytm stands as India’s largest payment company by Users, Merchants, Payment
Transactions, and Revenue. Paytm’s mission is to drive financial inclusion across the nation and
bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology-led financial
services.
Paytm enables commerce for small merchants and distributes various financial services
offerings to its consumers and merchants in partnership with financial institutions. Paytm has
been a trailblazer in the merchant space by introducing innovative solutions like QR codes to
accept payments and the Sound-box to reconcile payments via voice alerts. Furthermore, we
are actively distributing loans to these partners via our 'Paytm for Business' application.

Role Overview
We are looking for a high-performing Hunter Account Director to drive net-new enterprise
business for Pi Commerce. This is a pure hunting role focused entirely on acquiring large
enterprise logos, owning complex end-to-end sales cycles, and driving meaningful revenue
growth.
Operating at the intersection of AI, SaaS, and customer engagement, you will be responsible for
positioning a highly differentiated platform directly to CXOs and executive leadership teams
across a diverse range of industries.

Key Responsibilities

 Own the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle — from initial prospecting and discovery to
commercial negotiation and closure.
 Drive new logo acquisition aggressively across large enterprises (BFSI, Retail, Telecom,
Healthcare, etc.).
 Build and manage a robust, qualified sales pipeline through outbound hunting, professional
networking, and strategic account mapping.
 Lead CXO-level conversations, masterfully articulating business value propositions around
AI-led customer engagement.
 Conduct deep, consultative discovery to thoroughly understand client challenges across
engagement, retention, and communication systems.
 Collaborate closely with internal Pre-Sales, Product, and Solutions teams to architect
tailored technical solutions and custom demos.
 Lead RFP/RFQ responses, comprehensive proposal development, and high-value
contract/commercial negotiations.
 Position Pi Commerce strategically as a large-scale business transformation platform,
distinct from transactional messaging or simple campaign tools.
 Maintain absolute CRM discipline, ensuring highly accurate revenue forecasting and clear
pipeline hygiene.
 Represent Paytm at major industry events, critical client summits, and high-profile strategic
forums.

What We’re Looking For
 5–8 years of elite track record in Enterprise SaaS / CPaaS / MarTech / AI platform
enterprise sales.
 Proven success in closing large, complex enterprise deals characterized by multi-
stakeholder structures and extended sales cycles.
 A fierce, dedicated hunter mindset with clear evidence of high performance in new business
and net-new logo acquisition.
 Extensive experience engaging, pitching to, and building long-term trust with CXOs,
business heads, and digital/marketing leaders.
 An ability to sell consultatively, naturally translating deep operational business problems into
elegant, technology-led solutions.
 Strong commercial acumen equipped with expert-level proficiency in deal structuring, risk
management, and commercial negotiations.
 Thrived and demonstrated high comfort levels working in fast-paced, fluid, and high-growth
organizational environments.

Why Join This Role

 Strategic Impact: Be a key pillar of a high-growth, strategic priority business unit embedded
within Paytm.
 Cutting-Edge Product: Sell a highly differentiated, category-defining AI-led enterprise
engagement platform.
 Scale & Transformation: Gain the opportunity to lead and impact large-scale
transformations across India's largest corporate enterprises.
 High Visibility: Enjoy a high-impact, visible executive track role with a direct line of sight to
overall revenue and national market expansion.

descriptionPlain:
About Us:  Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team: Finance Team is responsible for allocating resources, creating economic forecasts, reviewing opportunities for equity and debt financing, and other functions within your organization. 

About the Role:  The role includes managing all account payables and receivables, accounting operations, and Daily work of Reconciliation of Revenue & expense items. Managing a small set of team and Vendor Management.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Handling the accounting functions such as Procure to Pay accounting, GL accounting, Fixed Assets accounting, reporting, reconciliations, etc. 
2. Vendor payment management: - Should be well versed in vendor payment management.
3. Planning & driving month/ quarter/ year-end accounts closing activities within agreed timelines.
4. Ensuring Compliances of direct/indirect taxes along with all required approvals as per the company's policy. 
5. Liaising with various internal stakeholders or business users for settlement of vendor advances, timely clearance of vendor payments, and resolving their issues.
6. Maintaining and extracting reports/MIS at Cost center/Profit Center level.
7. Verification/Vouching of custom-related documents: - Bill of entry, Bill of Lading or Airway Bill, import license, Letter of Credit or LC, etc.


 Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

 1. Minimum experience in Accounting is 6 years -10 years in the Payable domain.
2.  Should have good knowledge of  Accounting entries, GST, TDS, and Foreign remittances
3. Must have worked in SAP Accounting.
4. Proficient in handling Statutory Audits, Tax Audits Internal Audits, and all other kinds of Audits as and when required by the company.
5. Should be well versed with all accrual and provisioning concepts and have knowledge of maintaining and extracting reports/MIS at the Cost center/Profit Center level.
6. Should have good knowledge of Good communication and strong interpersonal skills. 
7. Hard-working, detail-oriented, and good team player. 

 Education: Post-Graduation in Finance / Qualified CA / CA Intermediate

 Why join us ? : A collaborative output-driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager.

Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with an enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

descriptionBody:
About Us:  Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team: Finance Team is responsible for allocating resources, creating economic forecasts, reviewing opportunities for equity and debt financing, and other functions within your organization. 

About the Role: The role includes managing all account payables and receivables, accounting operations, and Daily work of Reconciliation of Revenue & expense items. Managing a small set of team and Vendor Management.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Handling the accounting functions such as Procure to Pay accounting, GL accounting, Fixed Assets accounting, reporting, reconciliations, etc. 
2. Vendor payment management: - Should be well versed in vendor payment management.
3. Planning & driving month/ quarter/ year-end accounts closing activities within agreed timelines.
4. Ensuring Compliances of direct/indirect taxes along with all required approvals as per the company's policy.
5. Liaising with various internal stakeholders or business users for settlement of vendor advances, timely clearance of vendor payments, and resolving their issues.
6. Maintaining and extracting reports/MIS at Cost center/Profit Center level.
7. Verification/Vouching of custom-related documents: - Bill of entry, Bill of Lading or Airway Bill, import license, Letter of Credit or LC, etc.


 Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

 1. Minimum experience in Accounting is 6 years -10 years in the Payable domain.
2.  Should have good knowledge of  Accounting entries, GST, TDS, and Foreign remittances
3. Must have worked in SAP Accounting.
4. Proficient in handling Statutory Audits, Tax Audits Internal Audits, and all other kinds of Audits as and when required by the company.
5. Should be well versed with all accrual and provisioning concepts and have knowledge of maintaining and extracting reports/MIS at the Cost center/Profit Center level.
